limits.horizon_basis: The longest protocol horizon at the block: Lender.expiry() = 259200 s (a liquidation stays open 3 days) and Delegation.epochDuration() = 259200 s (slashable-collateral epoch). It covers Lender.grace() = 43200 s (liquidations start after it), StakedCap.lockDuration() = 86400 s (linear vesting of notified yield), FeeAuction.duration() = 43200 s (Dutch auction decay) and interest accrual in DebtToken and the fractional-reserve vault. Not the 1-hour damage window. On the fork no keeper updates prices: the oracle (staleness 86600 s, last update 34908 s before the block, backup feed older) makes mint, burn, borrow and liquidations revert about 14 h after the block.

_in_scope_note: The program's core contracts (manifest program.notes): Vault/Minter/FractionalReserve are the cUSD CapToken; StakedCap is the stcUSD token. ABIs from the live sources (tasks/cap/release/compile_live.py). The linked libraries (VaultLogic, MinterLogic, FractionalReserveLogic, BorrowLogic, LiquidationLogic, ReserveLogic, ViewLogic) run by delegatecall inside these proxies, so their effects are attributed to them.
_protected_note: Never pranked, funded or counted as attacker accounts: AccessControl role holders at the block (admin timelock, ops multisig, Gelato sweeper, pausers, agent managers), every Delegation agent and its restaking network, the debt token, the fractional-reserve vaults, the oracle adapters and price sources, the insurance fund.

views._note: ERC4626 maxWithdraw = convertToAssets(balanceOf): falls if shares or the share price fall.

attacker_claims._note: Lender debt (DebtToken, 6 decimals, principal + interest) of an attacker account is a liability: borrowing is not profit. cUSD and stcUSD balances are already measured as tokens.

invariants._note: VaultLogic/FractionalReserveLogic move totalSupplies, totalBorrows and loaned together with the USDC itself (mint +in, burn -(out+fee), borrow/repay, invest/divest; interest beyond loaned goes to interestReceiver), so idle + loaned + borrowed >= supplied, equal up to donations. At the block: 8051704316 + 7121595143169 + 49912371941619 >= 57042018556606.

cUSD is minted and burned against totalSupplies(USDC) at oracle prices, so supply / backing stays where it is (at the block 57042309021764193623174608 cUSD vs 57042018556606 USDC, ratio 1.000005). 0.01% tolerance for that historical drift; a break means cUSD not backed by accounted USDC.

StakedCap.totalAssets = storedTotal - lockedProfit <= storedTotal <= cUSD balance (deposits add to both, notify raises storedTotal to the balance). At the block 55672092423839245833248656 >= 55670203332273579545237747.

The vault's receivable must be owed by agents: DebtToken supply (principal + accrued interest) >= totalBorrows(USDC) (BorrowLogic: borrow/realize/repay move both; realizeInterest only realizes interest already in the supply). At the block 49913782648221 >= 49912371941619. 1 USDC tolerance for scaled-balance rounding.

probes._note: A real holder redeems 1,000 cUSD for USDC (Vault.burn; quote at the block 999994898 USDC units, fee 0). If an exploit stops it, the lockbox's cUSD is frozen.
A real holder redeems 1,000 stcUSD shares for cUSD (ERC4626.redeem, no cooldown in StakedCap).

trusted_actions._note: Routine automation: the Gelato sweeper (config/cap-infra.json infra.gelatoSweeper) holds the investAll role at the block and moves idle USDC into the fractional-reserve vault. Program rules: admins and their automation are trusted; a PoC may need this step after its own mint.

_price_feeds_note: None. The program does not count oracle manipulation: price sources are Chainlink (external integration, out of scope) set by trusted oracle admins. No _setPrice moves are allowed for Cap.

benign_entry_points._note: By design the liquidator repays debt and receives slashed restaker collateral plus a bonus.
By design anyone buys all accrued fee assets for the current Dutch-auction price in cUSD; buying when the price decayed below their value is the intended arbitrage, not theft.
By design moves accrued cUSD to stcUSD and the protocol-fee share to the protocol fee receiver.
